cryptographic_boundary.physical_boundary: Host hardware platform enclosing hardware TPM 2.0 (ISO/IEC 11889) or PKCS#11 Level 4 HSM with active physical tamper detection and zeroization circuitry.
cryptographic_boundary.logical_boundary: Native shared libraries (oqs.dll, libsodium.dll) and Python cryptographic policy enforcement engine (platform_hsm_interface.py, cnsa2_policy_engine.py, pqc_algorithms.py).

zeroization_rationale: All ephemeral session keys, ratcheting states, and private keys in C/Python memory spaces are purged deterministically upon disconnection or process termination using native libsodium sodium_memzero() and memory_protection_engine.py.
